text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS23, Dragonfly Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze

The 4-1/2 Inch Oiled Bronze Dragonfly Door Knocker comes packaged with hardware to surface mount it on wood or metal doors. The Dragonfly Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze has beautiful detailing that is enhanced by the finish. This front door knocker is made out of sandcast brass. It is 4-1/2 inches tall and 6-1/2 inches wide.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Polished Brass and Bronze Nickel Silver

Features and Specifications of the Dragonfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 4-1/2
  • Width: 6-1/2"
  • Projection Off Door: 1"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
